why.title: Why {score}/10 for “{title}”
why.intro: Every point below comes from a rule and, where it can, a quote from the posting.

bot.welcome:
👋 Hi {name}! I send you fresh computer-science jobs in Bangladesh and remote jobs open to Bangladesh, each scored against your profile.

Setting up takes about a minute. What I keep about you, and why: /privacy.
bot.welcome_back: 👋 Welcome back, {name}! You're all set: /settings changes your preferences and /help lists everything I can do.

steps.tracks: 1/7 · Tracks Which career tracks do you want jobs from? Tap to select, then Next.
steps.refine: Refine your tracks Untick any area you don't want. Jobs in ticked areas still reach you.
steps.level: 2/7 · Experience Where are you in your career?
steps.where: 3/7 · Where Where can you work? Pick one or both.
steps.cities: Preferred cities (optional) Jobs in these cities score a little higher; jobs elsewhere in Bangladesh still reach you.
steps.job_types: 4/7 · Job types Which kinds of jobs do you want?
steps.skills: 5/7 · Skills Type your skills separated by commas (for example: Python, SQL, React), or skip for now.
steps.score: 6/7 · Match strictness Only send jobs that score at least…
steps.delivery: 7/7 · Delivery Each match as soon as it's found, or once a day?
steps.quiet: Quiet hours (optional) No alerts during these hours ({zone} time). They wait until the hours end.

bot.skills_unknown: Not in my list, kept as typed: {skills}
bot.skills_none: None yet: jobs are still matched on everything else.
bot.stale: That menu is out of date.
bot.started: 🚀 All set! Looking for your matches from the last {days} days. They arrive in a few minutes.
bot.started_later: 🚀 All set! Your first matches arrive with the next run.
bot.not_set_up: You're not set up yet. Send /start.
bot.finish_setup_first: Let's finish setting you up first.
bot.unknown_text: I didn't get that. /help lists what I can do.
bot.pause_usage: Use /pause to pause until you resume, or /pause N for N days (1–{max}).
bot.resumed: ▶️ Resumed. New matches will reach you again.
bot.slow_down: Too many requests. Please wait a minute.
bot.help: What I can do /settings change your preferences /tracks change your career tracks /skills change your skills /pause [days] pause alerts /resume resume alerts /privacy what I store and why /export download your data /delete delete your data /help this list
bot.privacy: Privacy I store your Telegram id, name and username, your settings and skills, and the jobs I matched for you with their scores, only to send you matching jobs. Job postings are read by AI services (Google Gemini, Groq) to extract their facts; your own data is never sent to them unless you send a CV, which is asked about first. Your data is never sold or shared. /delete removes all of it.
bot.delete_confirm: Delete all your data? Your settings, skills, matches and feedback are removed for good. You can start again any time with /start.
bot.deleted: 🗑 Done. Everything I stored about you is deleted.
